title: The First Cut Is the Deepest
feel: Strummed eighths with a pushed “and” of 2

alt_voicings.label: Colour
alt_voicings.note: G → Cadd9 → Dsus4 → D, keeping ring and little fingers anchored on strings 2–1

sections.name: Verse & chorus (cycle)
sections.note: Verses and choruses ride the same G–D–C–D cycle; follow the record for how many times.

why: A **pivot-finger economy** drill: G, Cadd9 and Dsus4 share the same 3rd-fret anchor on the top two strings.
hard_change: None of the changes is hard; the work is **keeping the voicings consistent** — same G grip, same anchor, every time.
theory: I–V–IV–V in G. Covers move it: Sheryl Crow plays it in D, Rod Stewart in C.
steps: Changes alone, slowly: G → Cadd9 → Dsus4 → D, anchor fingers never leaving the strings.
With the strum at 70% (about 66 bpm), pushing the “and” of 2.
With Cat Stevens's own recording (in G).
caveat: Key and chords agree across three sources, but no full section map was checked — count the cycles from the record.
